segments.name: Brain disorders
segments.description: Develops small molecule medicines for brain disorders with significant unmet need, targeting neuronal hyperexcitation in epilepsies and psychoses.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it operates as one segment focused on developing medicines for brain disorders with significant unmet need.
